_doc: Optional weekly editorial override for the homepage hero. Leave item_name empty to auto-pick top-1 by model_score from homepage_rows.json trending-now. Set item_name (exact match) to spotlight a specific item. image_override (full URL or absolute path) and blurb_override are optional. label defaults to 'Featured This Week'. cta_text defaults to 'Open →'.
label: Featured This Week
